title: 金門大橋（金門）~Kinmen Bridge
focus: 在強海流、大潮差與花崗岩海床上，以脊背橋、全套管基樁與預鑄節塊完成跨海公路橋~Building a sea-crossing road bridge on granite under strong currents and large tides with an extradosed main bridge, cased bored piles and precast segments
summary: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道連接大金門與小金門，全長約 5.4 公里，主橋為五塔六跨預力箱梁脊背橋，最大跨徑 200 公尺。本課從海況與荷載出發，拆解脊背索的受力分工、花崗片麻岩中的大口徑基樁、鋼箱圍堰樁帽、興達港預鑄節塊的海運與懸臂吊裝、索力量測與載重試驗，最後談海洋耐久與營運交接。~Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel between Greater and Lesser Kinmen; the route is about 5.4 km long and the main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed box-girder extradosed bridge with a longest span of 200 m. Starting from sea conditions and loads, the course unpacks how extradosed stays share load, large-diameter piles in granitic gneiss, steel box cofferdam pile caps, sea transport and cantilever erection of segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour, stay-force measurement and load testing, and finally marine durability and operational handover.

units.anchor: 深槽區鋼套管~Deep-channel steel casing
units.title: 金烈水道海況與荷載組合~Channel conditions and load cases
units.mechanism: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道，深槽區水深約 22 至 23 公尺，最大潮差約 6 公尺，海流可達約 1.6 m/s，冬季有東北季風、春季有濃霧、夏秋有颱風。對基礎與施工臨時結構而言，海流拖曳力、波浪力與潮位變化同時作用；對上部結構則以颱風風壓、地震與溫度為主。設計時要把永久狀態（營運、地震、颱風、船舶撞擊）與施工狀態（鋼套管、作業平台、懸臂）的荷載組合分開列出，因為施工中的臨時結構常比完工結構更脆弱，而且暴露在海上的時間以年計。~Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel, where the deep trough is about 22 to 23 m deep, the maximum tidal range is about 6 m and currents reach about 1.6 m/s, with the northeast monsoon in winter, fog in spring and typhoons in summer and autumn. Foundations and temporary works feel current drag, wave forces and tide changes at the same time, while the superstructure is governed by typhoon wind, earthquake and temperature. Design must list permanent states (service, earthquake, typhoon, ship impact) separately from construction states (steel casings, work platforms, cantilevers), because temporary structures are often more vulnerable than the finished bridge and stay exposed at sea for years.
units.model: 海流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U²。取 ρ = 1,025 kg/m³、C_D = 1.0、外套管直徑 D = 3.0 m、水深 h = 23 m、流速 U = 1.6 m/s，F = 0.5×1,025×1.0×3.0×23×1.6² ≈ 90.5 kN；若合力作用在半水深，海床處彎矩約 90.5×11.5 ≈ 1,041 kN·m。流速加倍時拖曳力變為 4 倍，約 362 kN。C_D、D 與作用點為教學假設。~Current drag F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U². With ρ = 1,025 kg/m³, C_D = 1.0, outer casing diameter D = 3.0 m, water depth h = 23 m and U = 1.6 m/s, F = 0.5×1,025×1.0×3.0×23×1.6² ≈ 90.5 kN; acting at mid-depth it gives a seabed moment of about 90.5×11.5 ≈ 1,041 kN·m. Doubling the velocity quadruples the drag to about 362 kN. C_D, D and the point of action are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以聲學都卜勒流速剖面儀（ADCP）與潮位站資料建立設計流速剖面，套管定位時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測位置與垂直度，並比較漲退潮最急時套管頂偏位與計算撓度；作業平台與臨時結構的荷載檢核經工程師簽認後才能使用。~Build the design current profile from acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) surveys and tide-gauge records, measure casing position and verticality with GNSS and inclinometers during placement, and compare casing-top drift at peak flood and ebb with the calculated deflection; platforms and temporary works are used only after their load checks are signed off by an engineer.
units.failure: 若以平均流速而非尖峰流速設計臨時套管與平台，漲退潮最急時套管偏移、鑽孔偏斜，樁身垂直度超出容許值，鋼筋籠無法順利下放或基樁偏心受力；颱風來襲前若未撤離施工船機，船舶走錨也可能撞擊已完成的墩柱。~Designing temporary casings and platforms for mean rather than peak current lets the casing drift and the bore wander at peak flow, so pile verticality exceeds tolerance, reinforcement cages cannot be lowered cleanly or the pile is loaded eccentrically; work vessels not withdrawn before a typhoon can drag anchor and strike finished piers.
units.misconception: 海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。~Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge.
units.practice: 海事工程應建立潮流與氣象作業門檻表（流速、風速、浪高、能見度），每日開工前檢核，超過門檻即停止吊裝與定位；颱風警報發布前完成船機撤離與臨時結構加固，並由監造單位確認紀錄。~Marine works need an operating-limit table for current, wind, wave height and visibility, checked before each shift, with lifting and positioning stopped when a limit is exceeded; before a typhoon warning, vessels are withdrawn and temporary works secured, with records confirmed by the supervising engineer.

units.anchor: 脊背索與低矮橋塔~Extradosed stays and low towers
units.title: 五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工~Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge
units.mechanism: 主橋為五塔六跨預力混凝土箱梁脊背橋，跨徑配置為 125 + 4×200 + 125 公尺，主橋長 1,050 公尺。脊背橋介於梁橋與斜張橋之間：橋塔較矮，脊背索以平緩角度錨在箱梁上，作用像體外預力，把水平壓力送入梁內並提供部分垂直支撐，箱梁仍需足夠梁深承擔大部分彎矩。索角平緩使活載造成的索應力幅較小，疲勞要求較寬鬆，部分準則因此允許較高的索應力比例。多塔連續時，中間塔沒有錨碇跨平衡，不對稱活載下要靠箱梁與墩塔勁度控制變形。~The main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed concrete box-girder extradosed bridge with spans of 125 + 4×200 + 125 m and a length of 1,050 m. An extradosed bridge sits between a girder bridge and a cable-stayed bridge: towers are short and stays anchor into the girder at a shallow angle, acting like external prestress that pushes compression into the girder and adds partial vertical support, while the girder still needs enough depth to carry most of the bending. The shallow angle keeps the live-load stress range in the stays small, so fatigue demands are milder and some guidelines allow a higher stress ratio. With several towers in a row, the inner towers have no anchor span to balance them, so girder and tower stiffness must control deformation under unbalanced live load.
units.model: 索力 T = 5,000 kN、索角 20° 時，垂直分量 V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN，水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN；斜張橋常見的 35° 則 V ≈ 2,868 kN、H ≈ 4,096 kN。以 f_pu = 1,860 MPa 計，0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa，0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa。數值為教學假設。~For a stay force T = 5,000 kN at 20°, the vertical component is V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN and the horizontal compression H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN; at a typical cable-stayed angle of 35°, V ≈ 2,868 kN and H ≈ 4,096 kN. With f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa and 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以全橋有限元素模型比較有無脊背索時的箱梁彎矩包絡與撓度，確認索與梁各自承擔的比例；設計審查時逐根檢查活載應力幅，據以決定該索採用脊背索或斜張索的容許應力與疲勞試驗要求。~Compare girder moment envelopes and deflections with and without the stays in a whole-bridge finite-element model to confirm the share carried by stays and girder; in design review check the live-load stress range of every stay to decide whether extradosed or cable-stayed allowable stresses and fatigue-test requirements apply.
units.failure: 若把脊背索當成斜張索、以高應力幅假設設計，可能過度保守；反之若實際應力幅偏大卻採用較高容許應力，錨頭與塔頂鞍座可能提早疲勞。多塔體系忽略不對稱活載時，中間塔頂偏移與箱梁開裂會超出預期。~Treating extradosed stays as cable-stays with a high assumed stress range can be over-conservative; conversely, using the higher allowable stress where the real range is large can fatigue anchorages and tower saddles early. Ignoring unbalanced live load in a multi-tower system lets inner-tower drift and girder cracking exceed expectations.
units.misconception: 脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。~An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way.
units.practice: 設計報告應列出每根索的活載應力幅並據以分類，寫明採用的容許應力比例與準則來源；多塔橋另列不對稱活載工況的塔頂位移與梁體應力檢核，並把結果交給施工監控作為比對基準。~The design report should tabulate the live-load stress range of each stay and classify it, stating the allowable stress ratio and its source guideline; multi-tower bridges also need a separate check of tower-top drift and girder stress under unbalanced live load, handed to construction monitoring as a reference.

units.anchor: 2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段~2.5 m pile rock socket
units.title: 花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁~Cased bored piles in granitic gneiss
units.mechanism: 金門大橋約有 532 支基樁，主橋樁徑 2.5 公尺，邊橋 2.0 公尺，引橋 1.5 公尺，以全套管場鑄鋼筋混凝土樁施工。海床下是堅硬且傾斜、深度變化大的花崗片麻岩，大口徑基樁必須貫入岩盤，以嵌岩段側阻力與端承力承擔墩柱的垂直力與彎矩。岩面傾斜時，套管下端只有一側先碰到岩盤，容易造成鑽頭偏斜、樁底不完整或套管無法密封，因此每支樁的入岩深度要依實測岩面調整，而不是套用統一樁長。~Kinmen Bridge has about 532 piles: 2.5 m diameter under the main bridge, 2.0 m under the side bridges and 1.5 m under the approaches, all built as fully cased cast-in-place reinforced-concrete piles. Beneath the seabed lies hard granitic gneiss with a sloping, variable rock head, so large piles must penetrate the rock and carry pier axial force and moment through socket side resistance and end bearing. On a sloping rock face the casing touches rock on one side first, which can deflect the bit, leave an incomplete toe or prevent sealing, so each pile's socket length must follow the rock head actually found rather than a uniform pile length.
units.model: 嵌岩側阻 Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s，取 D = 2.5 m、L_s = 6 m、f_s = 1.0 MPa：Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN；端承 q_b = 5 MPa、A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m²，Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN。合計約 71,700 kN，安全係數 2.5 時容許約 28,700 kN。f_s、q_b、L_s 為教學假設。~Socket side resistance Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s with D = 2.5 m, L_s = 6 m and f_s = 1.0 MPa gives Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN; end bearing with q_b = 5 MPa on A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m² gives Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN. The total is about 71,700 kN, or about 28,700 kN allowable with a factor of safety of 2.5. f_s, q_b and L_s are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鑽掘時逐樁記錄入岩深度、岩屑性質與鑽進速率，並與地質鑽探柱狀圖比對；完成後以超音波井測檢查樁身完整性，抽樣鑽心確認樁底與岩盤接觸，代表性墩位以動態或雙向荷重試驗驗證承載力。~During boring, log socket depth, cuttings and penetration rate for every pile and compare with borehole logs; afterwards check integrity by cross-hole sonic logging, core selected piles to confirm toe contact with rock, and verify capacity at representative piers by dynamic or bidirectional load tests.
units.failure: 樁底殘留沉泥或岩屑時，端承力大幅下降，基樁受載後產生額外沉陷；岩面傾斜使樁趾一側懸空、嵌岩有效長度不足，墩柱出現不均勻沉陷與樁帽開裂。~Sediment or cuttings left at the toe sharply reduce end bearing and cause extra settlement under load; a sloping rock head that leaves one side of the toe unsupported shortens the effective socket, producing differential pier settlement and pile-cap cracking.
units.misconception: 只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。~Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock.
units.practice: 規範應把入岩深度而非樁底高程列為停止條件，由地質工程師在現場確認岩性與岩面後簽認；清孔與沉泥厚度檢查列為澆置混凝土前的停留點，未合格不得澆置。~The specification should make socket length into rock, not toe elevation, the termination criterion, signed off on site by a geotechnical engineer who has confirmed the rock type and rock head; base cleaning and sediment-thickness checks are a hold point before concreting.

units.anchor: 鋼箱圍堰封底混凝土~Steel box cofferdam seal
units.title: 鋼箱圍堰與海中樁帽~Steel box cofferdams and marine pile caps
units.mechanism: 深槽區主橋與邊橋的樁帽以鋼箱圍堰施工，公開報導稱是國內首次採用。鋼箱在海上組裝後下放包住樁頭，先在水下澆置封底混凝土，再抽乾箱內海水，讓樁帽在乾燥環境中綁筋與澆置。抽水後海水壓力從下方頂住封底板，所以封底混凝土必須靠自重、與樁身的握裹以及鋼箱摩擦共同抵抗上浮；報導提到下放時須抵抗約 4,000 公噸的海水浮力。~The pile caps of the main and side bridges in the deep trough were built inside steel box cofferdams, reported as a first in Taiwan. The box is assembled at sea and lowered around the pile heads, a seal slab is concreted underwater, and the box is then pumped dry so the cap can be reinforced and cast in the dry. After dewatering, sea pressure pushes up on the seal slab, so its self-weight, its bond to the piles and friction on the box walls must together resist uplift; reports mention about 4,000 t of buoyancy to overcome during lowering.
units.model: 上浮壓力 p = ρ·g·h = 1.025×9.81×6.5 ≈ 65.4 kPa；底面積 A = 30×20 = 600 m² 時總上浮力約 39,200 kN，約 4,000 公噸。只靠自重需封底厚 65.4/24 ≈ 2.7 m；若封底只取 1.5 m，其餘 (65.4 − 36)×600 ≈ 17,600 kN 須由樁身握裹承擔。尺寸與水頭為教學假設。~Uplift pressure p = ρ·g·h = 1.025×9.81×6.5 ≈ 65.4 kPa; on A = 30×20 = 600 m² the total uplift is about 39,200 kN, or about 4,000 t. Self-weight alone would need a seal 65.4/24 ≈ 2.7 m thick; with a 1.5 m seal, the remaining (65.4 − 36)×600 ≈ 17,600 kN must be carried by pile bond. Dimensions and head are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 封底混凝土以導管法連續澆置，持續量測澆置面高程與導管埋深；抽水分階段進行，每階段量測箱內水位、封底板變形、鋼箱應變與滲漏量，與設計上浮檢核比對，確認無異常後才進入下一階段。~Place the seal by tremie continuously while measuring concrete level and tremie embedment; dewater in stages and at each stage record inner water level, seal-slab deformation, box strains and leakage, comparing them with the uplift check before proceeding.
units.failure: 封底混凝土夾泥或厚度不足時，抽水後封底板開裂、湧水甚至整體上浮；鋼箱下放偏位會使樁頭與箱壁碰撞，樁帽保護層不足，日後成為海水滲入的弱點。~A seal containing mud lenses or built too thin can crack, let water burst in or even float the whole box after dewatering; a box lowered off position can clash with pile heads and leave thin cover on the cap, a future path for seawater.
units.misconception: 鋼箱圍堰只是擋水的模板，抽水時不會產生很大的力。~A steel box cofferdam is only a formwork that keeps water out, so dewatering creates no large forces.
units.practice: 抽水作業列為停留點：封底強度達標、潛水員檢查封底面與樁身介面、量測儀器就位後，由工程師核准分段抽水；每階段設停止條件，例如滲水量或變形超過預警值即停止並回灌。~Make dewatering a hold point: once the seal reaches strength, divers have checked the seal and pile interfaces and instruments are installed, the engineer authorises staged pumping; each stage has stop criteria, such as leakage or deformation beyond alert values triggering a halt and re-flooding.

units.anchor: 短線匹配澆鑄台座~Short-line match-casting cell
units.title: 興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸~Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出，上部結構使用 376 塊預鑄節塊，於高雄興達港生產後以船舶運到金門吊裝。預鑄節塊通常以短線匹配澆鑄：新節塊緊貼前一塊已完成的節塊澆置，接縫面完全吻合，到現場再依相同順序拼裝。這讓混凝土品質與養護在工廠條件下控制，但每一塊的幾何誤差會沿懸臂累積，所以澆鑄台座的測量與修正是全橋線形的源頭。長距離海運還增加堆置、繫固與天候窗口的不確定性，生產節奏必須與吊裝節奏協調。~Public reports state that the superstructure used 376 precast segments, produced at Hsing-ta Harbour in Kaohsiung and shipped to Kinmen for erection. Such segments are usually short-line match-cast: each new segment is cast against the previous one so the joint faces fit exactly, and they are erected in the same order on site. Concrete quality and curing are controlled under factory conditions, but each segment's geometric error accumulates along the cantilever, so survey and correction in the casting cell are the source of the whole bridge's alignment. Long sea transport adds uncertainty in storage, sea-fastening and weather windows, so production must be paced with erection.
units.model: 若第 2 號節塊接縫有 0.5 mrad 的角度誤差，其後懸臂長度 95 m，懸臂端偏差 Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm；同樣誤差若出現在倒數第二塊、其後只剩 5 m，只造成約 2.5 mm。越靠近墩頂的誤差影響越大。數值為教學假設。~If the joint of segment 2 has a 0.5 mrad angular error and 95 m of cantilever follows it, the tip deviates by Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm; the same error in the second-last segment, with only 5 m beyond, causes about 2.5 mm. Errors near the pier matter most. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每塊澆置後量測匹配節塊上的控制點高程與平面位置，以幾何控制程式比較實測與理論，於下一塊澆置時修正匹配節塊位置；出廠前檢查剪力鍵、預力孔道位置與強度紀錄，裝船時確認支墊與繫固符合計畫。~After each cast, survey the control points on the match-cast segment in level and plan, compare with theory in the geometry-control software and correct the match segment's position for the next cast; before shipment check shear keys, duct positions and strength records, and confirm bearing pads and sea-fastening against the plan.
units.failure: 若量測只記錄誤差而不在後續節塊修正，偏差累積到懸臂端，合龍時高程差過大，只能以強制頂撐或加厚合龍段處理並造成附加應力；運輸時繫固不良則可能使節塊邊角破損、剪力鍵受損而影響接縫傳力。~If errors are merely recorded and not corrected in later segments, they accumulate to the tip and the closure shows a large level difference, forcing jacking or a thickened closure with added stresses; poor sea-fastening can chip edges and damage shear keys, impairing joint load transfer.
units.misconception: 預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。~Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site.
units.practice: 幾何控制應由獨立的測量與分析小組負責，每塊節塊建立理論、實測與修正三欄紀錄；運輸與吊裝前定義吊點、支墊位置與繫固方式，並確認混凝土強度已達吊裝規定。~Geometry control belongs to an independent survey and analysis team that keeps a theory, as-cast and correction record for every segment; lifting points, support positions and sea-fastening are defined before transport, and concrete strength must meet the lifting requirement.

units.anchor: 墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩~Unbalanced moment at pier head
units.title: 平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍~Balanced-cantilever erection and closure
units.mechanism: 主橋與邊橋採懸臂工法：節塊從墩頂向兩側對稱吊裝，以預力鋼腱把新節塊壓緊在已完成的懸臂上，直到相鄰懸臂在跨中接近，再澆置合龍段使結構連續。施工中墩柱與基礎要承擔兩側重量差、吊裝設備與風荷載，常以臨時錨定、臨時支撐或墩梁臨時固結來穩定。合龍後結構由懸臂體系轉為連續體系，預力、溫度與潛變效應重新分配。金門大橋在 2022 年 7 月 22 日完成全橋合龍。~The main and side bridges were built by the cantilever method: segments are erected symmetrically outward from each pier head and stressed against the completed cantilever until neighbouring cantilevers meet near mid-span, where a closure pour makes the girder continuous. During erection the pier and foundation carry the weight imbalance, lifting equipment and wind, usually stabilised by temporary ties, props or a temporary pier–girder fixity. After closure the structure changes from cantilevers to a continuous system, redistributing prestress, temperature and creep effects. Kinmen Bridge achieved full closure on 22 July 2022.
units.model: 一側先吊一塊 1,500 kN 節塊、距墩中心 95 m 時，不平衡彎矩 M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m；若臨時錨定的力臂為 4 m，需拉力約 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN。節塊重量與力臂為教學假設。~Lifting one 1,500 kN segment on one side at 95 m from the pier centre gives an unbalanced moment M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m; with a 4 m lever arm, the temporary tie must carry about 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN. Segment weight and lever arm are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次吊裝前以施工階段分析核對允許的不平衡量，吊裝中量測墩頂傾斜與懸臂端高程；合龍前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端相對高程與間距隨溫度的變化，選擇溫度穩定時段鎖定合龍段並澆置。~Before every lift, check the permitted imbalance against the construction-stage analysis, and monitor pier-head tilt and tip levels during lifting; before closure, record the relative level and gap of the two tips against temperature for 24 hours and lock and cast the closure in a thermally stable window.
units.failure: 吊裝順序錯誤或一側吊具重量超出計畫，墩頂不平衡彎矩超過臨時錨定能力，懸臂可能傾覆；合龍時段選在日照急劇變化時，合龍段混凝土在硬化中受到拉伸而開裂。~A wrong lifting sequence or heavier rigging on one side can push the unbalanced moment past the temporary tie capacity and overturn the cantilever; closing during rapid solar heating can pull the closure concrete apart while it hardens and crack it.
units.misconception: 平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。~In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.
units.practice: 施工計畫應明訂允許的最大不平衡節塊數、吊具重量與風速上限，合龍段設臨時鎖定裝置；合龍時段與預力張拉順序列為停留點，由設計單位與監造共同核准。~The erection plan should state the maximum number of unbalanced segments, rigging weight and wind limit, and provide temporary locking at the closure; the closure window and stressing sequence are hold points approved jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.

units.anchor: 脊背索頻率量測~Stay frequency measurement
units.title: 脊背索索力量測與調整~Stay-force measurement and adjustment
units.mechanism: 脊背索的初張力決定箱梁應力分布與線形，因此施工中與完工後都要量測索力。最常用的是振動法：以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再由弦振動公式換算張力；但脊背索比斜張索短而粗，彎曲勁度、減振器與錨具邊界條件的影響較大，必須修正。另一種直接方法是以千斤頂做頂升試驗，量測錨頭開始離開承壓板時的油壓。兩種方法互相校正後，頻率法才適合用於長期監測。~The initial tension in the stays sets the girder's stress distribution and profile, so stay forces are measured during construction and after completion. The usual method is vibration-based: accelerometers record the stay's natural frequencies, which a taut-string formula converts to tension. Extradosed stays are shorter and stiffer than cable-stays, so bending stiffness, dampers and anchorage boundary conditions matter more and must be corrected. A direct alternative is the lift-off test, reading jack pressure when the anchor head just separates from its bearing plate. Only after the two methods are cross-calibrated is the frequency method fit for long-term monitoring.
units.model: 張緊弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f₁²。取單位長質量 m = 60 kg/m、自由長度 L = 60 m、實測第一頻率 f₁ = 2.5 Hz：T = 4×60×60²×2.5² = 5,400,000 N ≈ 5.4 MN。因 T ∝ f²，頻率量測誤差 2% 會造成約 4% 的索力誤差。數值為教學假設。~Taut-string formula T = 4·m·L²·f₁². With m = 60 kg/m, free length L = 60 m and a measured first frequency f₁ = 2.5 Hz, T = 4×60×60²×2.5² = 5,400,000 N ≈ 5.4 MN. Because T ∝ f², a 2% frequency error gives about a 4% force error. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每根索取前三階頻率，檢查是否接近整數倍以判斷彎曲勁度影響；抽樣以頂升試驗校正頻率法，記錄溫度與施工階段；與設計索力的差異須在規定允差內（例如 ±5%），否則依調索程序調整。~Record the first three frequencies of each stay and check how close they are to integer multiples to judge bending-stiffness effects; calibrate the frequency method by lift-off tests on a sample, noting temperature and construction stage; deviations from design forces must be within the specified tolerance, such as ±5%, or the stay is adjusted under the retensioning procedure.
units.failure: 忽略彎曲勁度、減振器與套管對有效長度的影響時，短索換算索力可能偏差一成以上，據此調索反而使箱梁應力偏離設計；錨頭夾片咬合不良則會在長期使用後滑移，使索力逐年下降。~Ignoring bending stiffness and the effect of dampers and guide pipes on effective length can misjudge short-stay forces by more than ten percent, so retensioning on that basis drives girder stresses away from design; poorly seated wedges can slip over years of service and let the force decline.
units.misconception: 只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。~Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length.
units.practice: 索力驗收報告應附原始頻譜、採用的有效長度與修正方法、量測溫度與施工階段；調索須依設計提供的順序與允差執行，最終索力表由設計單位確認後納入竣工資料。~The stay-force acceptance report should attach raw spectra, the effective length and correction method, temperature and construction stage; retensioning follows the designer's sequence and tolerances, and the final force table is confirmed by the designer and filed with the as-built records.

units.anchor: 跨中撓度與校驗係數~Mid-span deflection and check ratio
units.title: 線形驗收與通車前載重試驗~Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test
units.mechanism: 通車前要確認完成的橋梁與設計模型一致：一是線形，量測橋面高程與預拱是否符合考慮潛變後的目標；二是以已過磅的載重車做靜態與動態試驗，比對實測撓度、應變與自然頻率。實測值通常略小於計算值，因為實際混凝土勁度、鋪面與護欄都提供額外勁度；若實測大於計算，可能代表開裂、支承異常或模型假設錯誤。卸載後的殘餘變形也很重要，它顯示結構是否仍在彈性範圍。~Before opening, engineers confirm that the finished bridge matches the design model: first the profile, checking deck levels and camber against targets that allow for creep; second, static and dynamic tests with weighed trucks, comparing measured deflections, strains and natural frequencies. Measured values are usually slightly below predictions because actual concrete stiffness, surfacing and barriers add stiffness; values above prediction may signal cracking, bearing problems or wrong model assumptions. Residual deformation after unloading also matters, showing whether the structure stayed elastic.
units.model: 校驗係數 η = 實測/計算。某 200 m 跨跨中計算撓度 45 mm、實測 38 mm，η = 38/45 ≈ 0.84；卸載後殘餘 3 mm，殘餘比 3/38 ≈ 7.9%。預拱量級可由懸臂端 δ = P·L³/(3EI) 估計：P = 1,500 kN、L = 95 m、E = 35 GPa、I = 150 m⁴，δ ≈ 82 mm。數值為教學假設。~Check ratio η = measured/calculated. A 200 m span with 45 mm calculated and 38 mm measured mid-span deflection gives η = 38/45 ≈ 0.84; 3 mm residual after unloading gives 3/38 ≈ 7.9%. Camber magnitude can be estimated from a cantilever tip δ = P·L³/(3EI) with P = 1,500 kN, L = 95 m, E = 35 GPa and I = 150 m⁴, giving δ ≈ 82 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗前依有限元素模型決定車位與加載分級，先預載消除間隙；量測採精密水準、全站儀或位移計並同步記錄溫度。允收常以校驗係數小於 1.0、殘餘比低於規定值（例如 20%）且無新增裂縫為準，結果寫入竣工基準資料。~Set truck positions and load steps from the finite-element model, preload to close gaps, then measure with precise levelling, total stations or displacement transducers while recording temperature. Acceptance usually requires a check ratio below 1.0, a residual ratio below the specified value such as 20% and no new cracks; the results enter the as-built baseline.
units.failure: 試驗在日照強烈時進行而未做溫度修正，熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級而造成誤判；載重車未逐輛過磅，計算值本身就有誤差，校驗係數失去意義。~Testing in strong sun without temperature correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection and lead to misjudgement; trucks not individually weighed make the calculated values wrong and the check ratio meaningless.
units.misconception: 載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。~If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.
units.practice: 載重試驗計畫須明訂車輛過磅、分級加載、每級穩定時間、停止條件與允收標準，並把試驗結果、線形量測與索力表一起納入竣工基準檔案，作為日後監測比較的起點。~The load-test plan must specify truck weighing, load steps, hold time per step, stop criteria and acceptance limits, and the results go into the as-built baseline together with the profile survey and stay-force table as the starting point for future monitoring.

units.anchor: 混凝土保護層與氯離子~Concrete cover and chlorides
units.title: 海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計~Concrete durability in the strait
units.mechanism: 金門大橋位於海峽中，飛沫帶與潮汐帶的混凝土同時受氯離子滲透、乾濕循環與鹽霧作用；氯離子到達鋼筋位置並超過臨界含量後，鈍化膜破壞，鋼筋開始腐蝕，鏽蝕膨脹使保護層剝落。耐久對策包括加大保護層、降低水膠比、使用卜作嵐材料降低擴散係數、環氧樹脂塗布或耐蝕鋼筋、表面保護與陰極防蝕，2013 年國道新建工程局的考察報告也列出這些方向。不同高程的暴露差異很大，墩柱潮汐帶與樁帽頂面通常最嚴重。~Kinmen Bridge stands in a strait where concrete in the splash and tidal zones suffers chloride ingress, wetting and drying and salt spray; once chlorides reach the reinforcement above a critical content, the passive film breaks down, the bars corrode and expanding rust spalls the cover. Countermeasures include larger cover, lower water–binder ratio, pozzolans to lower diffusivity, epoxy-coated or corrosion-resistant bars, surface protection and cathodic protection, directions also listed in a 2013 study report of the national expressway engineering bureau. Exposure varies strongly with elevation, and the tidal zone of piers and the top of pile caps are usually worst.
units.model: Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。取保護層 x = 75 mm、擴散係數 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 100 年：√(D·t) ≈ 0.0562 m，x/(2√(D·t)) ≈ 0.668，C/C_s ≈ 0.345；若 D 為 3×10⁻¹² m²/s，C/C_s 升到約 0.586。數值為教學假設。~Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With cover x = 75 mm, diffusivity D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and t = 100 years, √(D·t) ≈ 0.0562 m, x/(2√(D·t)) ≈ 0.668 and C/C_s ≈ 0.345; with D = 3×10⁻¹² m²/s, C/C_s rises to about 0.586. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工時以保護層測定儀抽檢鋼筋保護層，以快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗驗證配比；營運後定期在潮汐帶與飛沫帶鑽取粉末，量測氯離子濃度剖面並擬合實際擴散係數，與設計假設比較。~During construction, spot-check cover with a covermeter and verify the mix by rapid chloride permeability or diffusion tests; in service, periodically drill powder samples in the tidal and splash zones, measure chloride profiles, fit the actual diffusivity and compare it with the design assumption.
units.failure: 保護層不足或局部蜂窩處，氯離子在十幾年內就到達鋼筋，出現鏽水、裂縫與剝落；樁帽頂面若排水不良、乾濕交替，腐蝕會集中在不易檢查的部位，發現時已需大範圍修補。~Where cover is thin or honeycombed, chlorides reach the steel within a decade or two, causing rust stains, cracks and spalls; poorly drained pile-cap tops that wet and dry concentrate corrosion where inspection is hard, so damage is found only when large repairs are needed.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。~Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode.
units.practice: 施工規範應把保護層量測與間隔物檢查列為澆置前停留點，潮汐帶的接縫與修補須使用經認可的材料；在代表性位置預埋耐久監測探頭或預留取樣點，建立長期氯離子資料。~The specification should make cover measurement and spacer inspection a hold point before concreting, and require approved materials for joints and repairs in the tidal zone; durability probes or sampling points at representative locations build a long-term chloride record.

units.anchor: 伸縮縫與支承行程~Joint and bearing travel
units.title: 伸縮縫、支承與營運交接~Joints, bearings and operational handover
units.mechanism: 全橋由主橋、兩側邊橋與多個引橋單元組成，各單元之間以伸縮縫分隔，支承配置決定每個單元哪裡固定、哪裡可滑動。溫度、乾縮與潛變讓梁體長度持續變化，伸縮縫與滑動支承必須提供足夠行程，同時承受車輛衝擊與鹽霧侵蝕。交接時管理單位需要的不只是竣工圖，還包括各單元固定點位置、支承與伸縮縫設計行程、竣工時的初始開口與當時溫度，作為日後判斷異常位移的基準；公開報導也提到通車後將依強風情況實施交通管制。~The crossing consists of the main bridge, two side bridges and several approach units separated by expansion joints, and the bearing layout decides where each unit is fixed and where it slides. Temperature, shrinkage and creep keep changing girder length, so joints and sliding bearings need enough travel while resisting traffic impact and salt spray. At handover the operator needs more than as-built drawings: the fixed point of each unit, design travel of bearings and joints, and the initial joint openings with the temperature at completion, as the baseline for spotting abnormal movement; public reports also note traffic control during strong winds after opening.
units.model: 假設一個 1,050 m 連續單元以中央為不動點，端部受影響長度 525 m。溫度變化 30 °C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×525×30 ≈ 0.158 m；乾縮與潛變應變 250×10⁻⁶：250×10⁻⁶×525 ≈ 0.131 m，伸縮縫需涵蓋兩者再加安裝誤差。單元劃分與參數為教學假設。~Assume a 1,050 m continuous unit fixed at its centre, so 525 m acts on each end. A 30 °C change gives ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×525×30 ≈ 0.158 m; shrinkage and creep strain of 250×10⁻⁶ add 250×10⁻⁶×525 ≈ 0.131 m, and the joint must cover both plus installation tolerance. Unit layout and parameters are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 竣工時記錄每道伸縮縫開口與當時梁溫；營運後在不同季節重測，繪出開口與溫度的關係，斜率應接近 α·L，若偏離或出現持續漂移，代表支承卡滯或墩柱位移。支承檢查滑動面磨耗、錨栓與防塵罩。~Record every joint opening with girder temperature at completion; re-measure in different seasons and plot opening against temperature, whose slope should approach α·L, while deviation or steady drift signals seized bearings or pier movement. Inspect bearing sliding surfaces for wear, anchor bolts and dust covers.
units.failure: 支承滑動面因鹽霧腐蝕或積砂而卡滯，溫度力轉移到墩柱造成裂縫；伸縮縫行程不足時夏季頂死、冬季開口過大，車輛衝擊破壞錨定混凝土並使雨水與鹽分流到支承。~Sliding surfaces seized by salt corrosion or trapped sand transfer thermal forces into the piers and crack them; joints with too little travel close up in summer and gape in winter, and traffic impact breaks the anchoring concrete and lets water and salt reach the bearings.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。~Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally.
units.practice: 交接清冊應包含伸縮縫與支承的型號、行程、初始設定與溫度、更換程序與交通維持計畫，以及索力基準與載重試驗資料；並約定巡查週期與颱風、地震後的特別檢查表，明訂由哪個單位簽認。~The handover register should list joint and bearing types, travel, initial settings and temperatures, replacement procedures and traffic-management plans, together with the stay-force baseline and load-test data; it should also fix inspection intervals and special post-typhoon and post-earthquake checklists, naming who signs them off.

example: 設計練習：一個 200 m 跨的脊背橋跨，箱梁恆載 w = 300 kN/m，假設脊背索承擔 30% 的恆載，每跨共 16 根索。索承擔的總垂直力 = 300×200×0.3 = 18,000 kN，每根 V = 18,000/16 = 1,125 kN。索角 20° 時索力 T = V/sin20° = 1,125/0.342 ≈ 3,289 kN，送入箱梁的水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 3,091 kN。單股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線面積 140 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa：以 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa 計需 3,289,000/(1,116×140) ≈ 21.1，取 22 股；若因應力幅大改用 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa，需約 28.1，取 29 股。若把索角提高到 25°，T ≈ 2,662 kN，以 0.6 f_pu 計只需約 17.0，取 18 股，但橋塔要更高。數值為教學假設，不代表金門大橋的設計。~Design exercise: a 200 m extradosed span has a girder dead load w = 300 kN/m, and the stays are assumed to carry 30% of it with 16 stays per span. The total vertical stay force is 300×200×0.3 = 18,000 kN, so each stay carries V = 18,000/16 = 1,125 kN. At 20° the stay force is T = V/sin20° = 1,125/0.342 ≈ 3,289 kN and the horizontal compression into the girder is H = T·cos20° ≈ 3,091 kN. With 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² and f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa needs 3,289,000/(1,116×140) ≈ 21.1, so 22 strands; if a large stress range forces 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa, about 28.1 are needed, so 29 strands. Raising the angle to 25° gives T ≈ 2,662 kN and only about 17.0, so 18 strands, at 0.6 f_pu, but the towers must be taller. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of Kinmen Bridge.
history: 連接大、小金門的固定橋梁自 1993 年開始規劃，2010 年由行政院核定計畫，由交通部國道新建工程局（後併入高速公路局）主辦、台灣世曦設計，2011 年起陸續施工。工程歷經兩次終止契約與重新發包，2016 年底由東丕營造接續主體工程，2022 年 7 月 22 日全橋合龍、10 月 30 日通車，主橋為國內最長跨徑的五塔六跨脊背橋。其工程意義在於深槽區鋼箱圍堰、花崗岩海床中的大口徑全套管基樁，以及在本島預鑄、跨海運輸後懸臂吊裝的節塊工法。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。~A fixed link between Greater and Lesser Kinmen was planned from 1993 and approved by the Executive Yuan in 2010, with the national expressway engineering bureau of the Ministry of Transportation (later merged into the Freeway Bureau) as owner and CECI Engineering Consultants as designer; works began in stages from 2011. After two contract terminations and re-tenders, a third contractor took over the main works at the end of 2016, the bridge closed on 22 July 2022 and opened on 30 October 2022, with Taiwan's longest-span five-tower extradosed main bridge. Its engineering significance lies in steel box cofferdams in the deep trough, large cased bored piles in granite and segments precast on Taiwan's main island, shipped across the strait and erected by cantilevering. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.
facts: 路線全長約 5.4 公里，其中跨海橋梁段約 4.77 公里~The route is about 5.4 km long, of which about 4.77 km is sea-crossing bridge
主橋為五塔六跨預力箱梁脊背橋，長 1,050 公尺，跨徑 125 + 4×200 + 125 公尺~The main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed box-girder extradosed bridge, 1,050 m long with spans of 125 + 4×200 + 125 m

邊橋為變梁深預力箱梁、懸臂工法，兩側各約 360 公尺；引橋為等梁深箱梁、支撐先進工法，主要跨徑約 50 公尺~Side bridges are variable-depth box girders built by cantilevering, about 360 m on each side; approaches are constant-depth box girders built with movable scaffolding, with main spans of about 50 m
橋面淨寬約 15 公尺，雙向各一車道並設人行與自行車道~The deck is about 15 m wide in clear width, with one traffic lane each way plus pedestrian and cycle lanes
深槽區水深約 22 至 23 公尺，最大潮差約 6 公尺，海流可達約 1.6 m/s~The deep trough is about 22 to 23 m deep, the maximum tidal range is about 6 m and currents reach about 1.6 m/s
全橋約 532 支全套管基樁，樁徑分為 2.5、2.0 與 1.5 公尺~About 532 fully cased bored piles were built, with diameters of 2.5, 2.0 and 1.5 m
主橋與邊橋共 11 座墩，深槽區樁帽以鋼箱圍堰施工~The main and side bridges have 11 piers, and the deep-trough pile caps were built in steel box cofferdams
上部結構使用約 376 塊在高雄興達港生產的預鑄節塊~The superstructure used about 376 precast segments produced at Hsing-ta Harbour, Kaohsiung
總經費約新台幣 96.6 億元，2022 年 10 月 30 日通車~Total cost was about NT$9.66 billion, and the bridge opened on 30 October 2022

timeline.event: 行政院核定金門大橋建設計畫，設計委由台灣世曦辦理~The Executive Yuan approves the Kinmen Bridge project, and design is assigned to CECI Engineering Consultants
小金門端引道工程開工，正式展開建設~Approach works at the Lesser Kinmen end begin, starting construction
主體工程先後兩次終止契約並重新發包~The main works contract is terminated twice and re-tendered
東丕營造取得接續主體工程，2016 年底復工~A third contractor wins the follow-on main works and resumes at the end of 2016
7 月 22 日全橋合龍，10 月 30 日正式通車~Full closure on 22 July and official opening on 30 October
